401421301.text: The mountain air is so refreshing! It makes Paimon feel like she could float around all day and never get tired!

401421307.text: Right? So Paimon wasn't just hearing things.

401421309.text: Well, we've got the time. Why don't we go check it out?

401421310.text: Okay. Let's go see what's up.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go and start up a conversation

401420201.text: Eh! What are they doing here!?

401420203.text: Ah! Well if it isn't my dear partners!

401420204.text: See! I told you that something good was going to happen during our travels today! I have to say, sometimes The Steambird's astrology column is spot on.

401420206.text: Are you guys also here to catch the festivities? Oh, and that reminds me, Happy Lantern Rite!

401420209.text: Happy Lantern Rite to you too!

401420210.text: Wait, if you're here for Lantern Rite, then what are you doing on top of this deserted mountain?

401420211.text: And that voice we heard... That was you, right Navia?

401420212.text: Oho, impressive! You could tell it was me from that far away! You've got good ears!

401420213.text: That, or your voice is just really loud...

401420214.text: Well of course it is! After all, I am a Boss.

401420215.text: Indeed. I suppose it's an asset.

401420216.text: Sure is! Having a loud voice is a handy tool when it comes to communication.

401420217.text: ...Wait wait wait! That wasn't even Paimon's point.

401420218.text: Paimon just wants to know why you two were shouting from the top of this deserted mountain.

401420219.text: There was something about Almonds maybe... and Bulle Fruit... Ooh! Is it some sort of secret code?

401420220.text: No, it's not a code. The words are meaningless.

401420221.text: ...Perhaps. But the act of shouting was very meaningful indeed!

401420222.text: That's just what mountain climbers do, right? After all the hard work it takes to make it to the top, as you stand on the summit looking out at the vast scenery, it's not easy to resist the urge to release those emotions...

401420226.text: I was afraid that it would cause a disturbance, so I asked the locals around here, and they said it was fine. Apparently, most hikers like to shout when they get to the top, so the locals are used to it by now.

401420227.text: So you see, it's not just me! I guess everyone shouts from the top of a mountain at some point in their life.

401420229.text: When you're stressed, don't you ever just get the urge to do something for no reason?

401420230.text: Not really. If I ever get stressed, I just go hunting.

401420231.text: Oh! That's a pretty good way to relieve stress.

401420233.text: What I choose to hunt depends on my mood.

401420235.text: Ahem... Anyway, why don't you two give it a try? Shout anything you want. It's a real stress reliever!

401420236.text: Hmm... as long as Paimon has clothes on her back and food in her belly, Paimon doesn't think there's any stress that needs relieving.

401420237.text: And I prefer to keep things bottled up.

401420238.text: Hahaha, I bet you guys are just too embarrassed to let loose.

401420239.text: No need to be shy! Even Furina was shouting from the top of this mountain earlier.

401420241.text: Huh? ...Did Paimon hear that right? Furina's also here in Qiaoying Village?

401420242.text: Believe in your ears. It is indeed as you heard.

401420243.text: Actually, the reason we climbed this mountain in the first place was also because we heard the sound of shouting.

401420244.text: Yep. We could just about make out someone yelling things like "Help me!" and "What should I do?". So we hurried up here to check it out.

401420245.text: And what do you know, Miss Furina was standing right there all red in the face. She practically sprinted back down the mountain the minute she saw us...

401420246.text: Ah, that reminds me. I believe what she actually said was, "So help me, I will figure out what I should do about this script."

401420247.text: So you could actually hear what she was saying! Why didn't you say so earlier? I thought someone was really in trouble!

401420248.text: I figured we would come check out the situation either way. Why not let her keep some privacy.

401420249.text: Uh... Seems like you caught Furina in the middle of some stress relief as well...

401420250.text: She probably would have never thought... No, she definitely would have never thought she would run into anyone she knew all the way out here...

401420252.text: I think so? We ran into Neuvillette on the way here as well, but he was already on his way back, so they probably weren't together.

401420255.text: What was he doing here? It couldn't have been for vacation...

401420256.text: I think it just might have been, actually. But apparently, he only stayed for half a day before heading back. He's a very busy man.

401420257.text: Neuvillette is not the type to take much time off. Taking even a half-day for himself is already a huge step in the right direction.

401420258.text: Didn't Charlotte publish an article on the Liyue tea industry recently? Maybe he was inspired to come buy some tea after reading that article. You know, just like you were!

401420259.text: My situation is completely different. I'm here because I was asked to accompany you. The tea purchase is simply an added bonus of this location.

401420260.text: You Fontainians and your tea drinking...

401420261.text: Oh, it's not for me. I lost a bet with Wriothesley, and now I have to buy him something.

401420301.text: Qiaoying Village is known for its tea. But you know what else they have with tea? That's right, dim sum!

401420302.text: Didn't Gaming say something about dim sum being eaten in the morning? Paimon wonders if we can still get some at this time of day.

401420303.text: Afternoon tea might be more appropriate at this point.

401420304.text: Oh, well that's fine too. Paimon doesn't care what kind of tea it is, as long as it comes with some tasty snacks!

401420305.text: Now, let's see what kinds of yummy things we can find around here... Uh...

401420306.text: P-Paimon's not seeing things, is she? Is that Furina standing between Zhongli and Hu Tao?

401420310.text: Zhongli knows a lot of stuff. Maybe he's telling Furina about Qiaoying Village?

401420311.text: ...Oh! Or maybe Hu Tao is trying to rope Furina into being one of her clients.

401420313.text: Hey, this isn't the Fortress of Meropide!

401420314.text: But, Paimon could be convinced for the right price. Let's say loser buys the winner three huge bowls of Seafood Congee!

401420315.text: Since Zhongli is there, Paimon bets things are pretty tame...

401420316.text: It's decided then! Paimon votes for "tour guide Zhongli"!

401420317.text: Then I vote for "hustler Hu Tao".

401420318.text: Alright! No time to waste! Let's go see who's right!

401420319.text: Good afternoon, Hu Tao, Zhongli, and Furina!!

401420321.text: Oho, well aren't you a sight for sore eyes! Seems like our luck just keeps on growing!

401420322.text: That we were able to meet you both without prior arrangement must mean that this is quite the serendipitous meeting indeed.

401420323.text: #Huh? Oh! So both of you are acquainted with {NICKNAME} and Paimon then.

401420701.text: Oh! Paimon almost forgot to ask the most important question!

401420702.text: Did, uh, something... happen recently, Furina?

401420704.text: Uh... Well, you know, with you enlisting the services of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and all...

401420707.text: Paimon is so sorry for your loss... Although Paimon may have not known the person, please accept Paimon's deepest—

401420708.text: Woah, woah, woah. It's not like that, Paimon!

401420709.text: Huh? But Paimon just thought... Since you hired the services of a Funeral Parlor and all... Hey, it's not that big of a stretch!

401420710.text: Really, Paimon. It's not like you don't know me. Do I look like I know anyone who would ask me to coordinate their funeral?

401420711.text: Miss Hu Tao is simply helping prepare some props for my film.

401420712.text: Not too long ago, I read a collection of horror stories from Liyue. The content was spectacular. In fact, I still feel the need to sleep with the light on even now...

401420714.text: Now that Fontaine's biggest star has returned to the stage, I figured it's about time the industry enjoyed a breath of fresh air!

401420715.text: You might even call it a "breath of fresh t-AIR-or"!

401420716.text: Hey, that's pretty good! I'll have to remember that for my ad posters.

401420717.text: Paimon sees! That makes a lot of sense.

401420718.text: So did you come to Liyue just to enlist the services of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor?

401420720.text: My original plan was to just relax and enjoy the sights. But then I ran into Miss Hu Tao and Mr. Zhongli, and well, you know the rest. I suppose it was meant to be.

401420721.text: It was a fated meeting indeed.

401420722.text: Zhongli sure loves his lofty turns of phrase. But if you ask me, it's all thanks to that man who stopped to ask for directions.

401420724.text: It's someone you know. Wanna take a guess?

401420727.text: What! How did you guess that on your first try!?

401420728.text: Very impressive, my friend. Your guessing game is spot on today!

401420729.text: You tell everyone about your encounter with Navia and Clorinde at the top of the mountain...

401420778.text: One look at the pitiful expression on Furina's face is enough to convince you to leave out the part about the shouting.

401420802.text: #{NICKNAME}, Miss Furina, those two individuals over there appear to recognize you.

401420805.text: We saw you all chatting over here, and were wondering if we could join in.

401420808.text: #No apologies necessary. Any friend of {NICKNAME} and Miss Furina is a friend of mine!

401420809.text: Ha, straight to the point. I like it!

401420810.text: Everyone circles around you and begins to introduce themselves.

401420879.text: Hu Tao's eyes light up when she hears about Clorinde's profession.

401420880.text: But a quick explanation from Furina and Navia seems to dispel some of her more misguided ideas.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the village beneath the mountain

401420401.text: #{NICKNAME}, look! It's Neuvillette! We lucked out!

401420402.text: Oh, it's you. It has been some time since our last meeting.

401420403.text: Few people frequent this location. Since I was able to conclude my work early for the day, I thought I might take a walk and avail myself of this area's peace and quiet.

401420404.text: You call this early...? Do you always work this late, Neuvillette?

401420405.text: Strictly speaking, that depends on the agenda for the day.

401420406.text: I am hardly bereft of time, however, so working late is of little consequence to me.

401420407.text: Really? If you have so much time on your hands, then why did you only go to Qiaoying Village for half a day?

401420409.text: First, I should clarify that I was referring to my lifespan rather than the time at my disposal on any given day.

401420410.text: Second... I was unaware you possessed knowledge of my trip to Qiaoying Village.

401420411.text: You give Neuvillette a quick summary of everything that happened today...

401420412.text: I see. Thank you for informing me.

401420413.text: So did you deliver the gifts?

401420414.text: Yes. They have been safely delivered.

401420415.text: I have to hand it to Clorinde.

401420416.text: Just a simple gift delivery, and she has the great and mighty Iudex at her beck and call.

401420417.text: I was just passing through. It was merely an act of convenience.

401420418.text: Alright. Then I hereby confirm receipt of the goods on behalf of the staff of the Fortress of Meropide.

401420419.text: A verbal receipt of confirmation? Is such a formality really necessary for a small matter such as this...

401420421.text: This quantity of tea, though... Seems a little excessive for a gift, don't you think? Before you know it, they'll start accusing me of taking bribes.

401420423.text: Much of that is my own excess, I'm afraid.

401420425.text: It was buy ten boxes get half off.

401420427.text: Well, go ahead and leave them to me. I'll get through this stash as fast as I can.

401420429.text: There's something else I'd like to give to you.

401420431.text: A stone... slate? Engraved with a symbolic design?

401420432.text: While that is an apt description, it is, in actuality, a legal codex.

401420434.text: Before the advent of modern writing utensils, information was recorded on stone slabs such as this. The law was no different.

401420436.text: Since ancient times, the scales of justice have symbolized the fairness and impartiality of judiciousness.

401420437.text: As a tribute to that sentiment, this slate was designed after a traditional legal codex and engraved with the symbol instead of text.

401420438.text: During my travels recently, I chanced upon a roadside stall offering tourists the opportunity to try their hand at the ceramic arts... So I decided to have a go...

401420439.text: We joked with Clorinde some time ago about gifting you a legal codex. So, here you go.

401420440.text: Ah, so that's what this is about.

401420441.text: I did not expect you to remember it as well. In any case, I hope this can be considered as a reasonable attempt to join in on the banter.

401420442.text: It is a very good attempt.

401420443.text: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised. Even your sense of humor centers around the law. That's an impressive level of commitment.

401420444.text: A gift of this significance deserves to be put on display, and I know just the place... Front and center in the Fortress's showroom.

401420445.text: Ah, surely there's no need for such a grand gesture...

401420446.text: Just kidding. I don't have anything like a showroom.

401420447.text: But we do have a storage room... We can put it next to all the mechanical parts Sigewinne has collected.

401420449.text: So that's what you were doing in Qiaoying Village!

401420450.text: Indeed. Of course, while I was there, I also took the opportunity to taste the local spring water.

401420451.text: The aftertaste is much purer than what I have delivered to me in Fontaine. It stands to reason that the long-distance transport has a tendency to imbue the water with extraneous emotion...

401420452.text: If you want to experience the true flavor, you simply have to go the source... Perhaps I should organize some time off to do the same elsewhere.

401420453.text: As they say in Liyue: "A balance between work and play is sure to keep your troubles at bay."

401420454.text: Then we are of the same mind. It appears my desire is justified.

401420455.text: If you say so. But you know you don't have to justify a vacation, right? You can just take one.

401420456.text: After all, you're hardly "bereft of time." You can do whatever you want.

401420457.text: You're quite right. I suppose I suffer not from a lack of opportunity but rather a lack of inspiration.

401420458.text: However, after reading a few articles about Liyue's holiday traditions, the idea popped into my head and made itself quite at home...

401420459.text: Seeing as I was free of responsibilities for the morning, I decided to depart at once.

401420461.text: Refreshing. My spontaneous outing seemed to inspire quite a few other spontaneous decisions as well.

401420462.text: Take, for example, my foray into ceramics. At first, soil from the ground is granular and unforgiving, but add the right amount of water, and it becomes soft, moldable, and able to take shape.

401420463.text: In the past, I never thought about how quotidian vessels were crafted. But now, I have participated in their very making.

401420464.text: This is also something I made today.

401420465.text: Oh wow. What a big... ladle?

401420466.text: That's a ladle? Paimon thought it was supposed to be some long-necked sea creature!

401420467.text: That was indeed one of my inspirations.

401420471.text: To tell you the truth, given your unexpected arrival, I find myself quite unequipped to give you the welcome you deserve.

401420472.text: Around an important holiday such as this, human custom would dictate that gifts should be in order...

401420473.text: But I'm afraid, this is all I can offer, if you'll have it, that is.

401420501.text: What do I have to do to get you to yell from the top of this mountain? Name your price.

401420502.text: You really want to hear it that bad, huh?

401420503.text: I'm just curious is all. I have a feeling you'll say something amazing.

401420505.text: I prefer to let actions speak louder than words.

401420901.text: Oh, that reminds me. A new year of work is about to begin.

401420902.text: If there's anything you want to talk about, Zhongli, you know you can come to me. I'm all ears.

401420903.text: Does the Director have any concerns?

401420904.text: It just seemed like you were a bit preoccupied today, and much less talkative than usual. You barely said anything other than "Is that so?" and "Indeed".

401420905.text: If you ask me, I'd say you're having a mid-life crisis. You're getting to be around that age, after all.

401420909.text: Given its distance from the city, Qiaoying Village enjoys a much slower pace of life.

401420910.text: Surrounded by such peace and tranquility, I also seem to have developed a proclivity for inactivity.

401420911.text: I apologize for making you worry.

401420913.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Is this atmosphere putting you in a lazy mood too?

401420916.text: Wow! You are getting really good at these kinds of lines!

401421001.text: Well, everyone, make sure that you've got all your belongings with you before we leave.

401421002.text: If there's any souvenirs anyone still wants to buy, the time is now.

401421004.text: Huh, what is that supposed to mean?

401421005.text: Clorinde is right, though. You really are reliable!

401421006.text: It's not what she's saying, it's the way she's saying it!

401421007.text: I will say, I never thought you'd be so easygoing outside of work, Clorinde.

401421008.text: The tone of voice you use when you're working doesn't exactly make you seem like the type who enjoys interacting with people.

401421009.text: Well, I try to keep my professional and private life separate. That includes my behavior.

401421011.text: Don't worry. Your partner is very strong.

401421012.text: Trying to act cool now, are we? Haha, well I guess it's not an act for you, is it?

401421014.text: Hahaha, it's been great talking to you all. I'm really glad I decided to come to Qiaoying Village.

401421015.text: Maybe we could go on another trip together sometime?

401421201.text: Lantern Rite marks the start of the new year in Liyue.

401421202.text: In the spirit of the season, then, I wish you a year of success as vast and endless as the open ocean.

401429903.text: Clorinde said Neuvillette offered to deliver her gifts to Wriothesley.

401429904.text: So if we go to the entrance of the Fortress of Meropide, maybe we'll run into Neuvillette!

401429905.text: But, we don't know exactly when he'll show up...
